verdict.rationale: Mollie documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp acting as a proxy for its public API, with documented API coverage (Payments, Balances, Subscriptions, Webhooks, etc.), scoped access tokens, and setup instructions for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and probe confirmation.
